LanguageData.VV_FailReason_ApocryphaInterference: Due to Apocrypha's interference, only the attunement ritual is possible.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_RequiresEverflowerAltar: Must be enshrined on the everflower altar.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementLocked: Can only be performed after receiving the vivi federation's missive.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementInProgress: The everflower is already condensing its final bloom.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementCompleted: The everflower has already fully bloomed.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GrandAttunementFailed: The everflower was usurped and can no longer be awakened.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_CoronationNotAnchor: Can only be performed on the everflower condensing its final bloom.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_CoronationLocked: Can only be performed once the bloom condensation is complete.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ResonanceWaveHit: The resonance wave strikes Apocrypha! (Resonance stacks: {STACKS}, incoming damage reduction: {REDUCTION})
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ReturnOfLife: Answering the call of the fully bloomed everflower, an ancient vivi once bound to the last queen of the old empire has returned to life.\n\nAfter ages as a fairy, {PAWN_labelShort} has regained a physical body and joined the colony.
